pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: r8152: disable RX aggregation on Dell TB16 dock r8153 on Dell TB15/16 dock corrupts rx packets. This change is suggested by Realtek. They guess that the XHCI controller doesn't have enough buffer, and their guesswork is correct, once the RX aggregation gets disabled, the issue is gone. ASMedia is currently working on a real sulotion for this issue. Dell and ODM confirm the bcdDevice and iSerialNumber is unique for TB16. Note that TB15 has different bcdDevice and iSerialNumber, which are not unique values. If you still have TB15, please contact Dell to replace it with TB16. BugLink: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/1729674 Cc: Mario Limonciello <mario.limonciello@dell.com> Signed-off-by: Kai-Heng Feng <kai.heng.feng@canonical.com> Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net> (cherry picked from commit 0b1655143df00ac5349f27b765b2ed13a3ac40ca) Signed-off-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> BUG=chromium:897895 TEST=test_that $IP BootPerf TEST=test_that $IP network_EthernetStressPlug --args num_iterations=1000,interface=eth0 Change-Id: I467a0e664ad3ddf644d3f55a77418076fcb9a99e Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1407329 Tested-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: r8152: fix wrong checksum status for received IPv4 packets The device could only check the checksum of TCP and UDP packets. Therefore, for the IPv4 packets excluding TCP and UDP, the check of checksum is necessary, even though the IP checksum is correct. Take ICMP for example, The IP checksum may be correct, but the ICMP checksum may be wrong. Signed-off-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com> Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net> (cherry picked from commit ea6499e160a74ea813e53e7bef2ccb22df1e4929) Signed-off-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> BUG=chromium:897895 TEST=test_that $IP BootPerf TEST=test_that $IP network_EthernetStressPlug --args num_iterations=1000,interface=eth0 Change-Id: I52df297598d51da59d7641db05401a648c72a7b6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1407330 Tested-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com>

UPSTREAM: r8152: set rx mode early when linking on Set rx mode before calling netif_wake_queue() when linking on to avoid the device missing the receiving packets. The transmission may start after calling netif_wake_queue(), and the packets of resopnse may reach before calling rtl8152_set_rx_mode() which let the device could receive packets. Then, the packets of response would be missed. Signed-off-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com> Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net> (cherry picked from commit aece4770fba62102951891c2f349a255c83eacb9) Signed-off-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> BUG=chromium:897895 TEST=test_that $IP BootPerf TEST=test_that $IP network_EthernetStressPlug --args num_iterations=1000,interface=eth0 Change-Id: I7547e0f3743159fa73ca45207811513e73fed3ec Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1407331 Tested-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Grant Grundler <grundler@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com>

UPSTREAM: net: usb: r8152: use irqsave() in USB's complete callback The USB completion callback does not disable interrupts while acquiring the lock. We want to remove the local_irq_disable() invocation from __usb_hcd_giveback_urb() and therefore it is required for the callback handler to disable the interrupts while acquiring the lock. The callback may be invoked either in IRQ or BH context depending on the USB host controller. Use the _irqsave() variant of the locking primitives. Cc: "David S. Miller" <davem@davemloft.net> Signed-off-by: Sebastian Andrzej Siewior <bigeasy@linutronix.de> Signed-off-by: David S. faft: Make sure attributes exist before cleanup uses them. Previously, if the test encountered problems during setup (such as /dev/tpm0 missing), it would skip creating self.switcher and self.ec, thus causing AttributeError noise during cleanup. Now those conditions are checked only after the attributes are created, or are checked using getattr. Thus, only the original setup failure appears, and the teardown failure noise is gone. BUG=None TEST=Run faft test while deleting /dev/tpm0 repeatedly so setup fails Change-Id: I650e481b9794dddc0041818af68eefca52c864ba Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1575748 Tested-by: Dana Goyette <dgoyette@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Dana Goyette <dgoyette@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kevin Shelton <kmshelton@chromium.org>

tpm_manager: catch a TPM error in Tpm2StatusImpl to avoid crashes This changes allows TpmStatus::CheckAndNotifyIfTpmOwned() to return an error in case a TPM error happens. Changing the function signature affects lots of code. There has been lots of crashes (see the bug) due to trunks tpm state initialization failures not being caught in Tpm2StatusImpl::CheckAndNotifyIfTpmOwned(). The function tried to ask for more tpm states from trunks w/o checking if the initialization succeeded. Doing so caused libtrunks to err. BUG=b:133647939 TEST=Unittests On both soraka and chell, tested affected tpm manager functionalities: 1. tpm initialization 2. get tpm status 3. define, read, and write NV space using owner write and auth write 4. reset DA lock Simulated trunks tpm states initialization failure and made sure calling CheckAndNotifyIfTpmOwned() didn't crash tpm_managerd Change-Id: I7838a6afd6885d5a1a37f0cd43de261878784427 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1658567 Tested-by: Wei-Cheng Xiao <garryxiao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Wei-Cheng Xiao <garryxiao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Louis Collard <louiscollard@chromium.org>
